cost_note: Published per-image rate for one Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image 1K output (confirmed against every prior Gemini Flash Lite receipt in this repo under marketing/campaigns/and-if-it-is-rattler-lifers/evidence/). The Gemini Developer API generateContent response does not include a per-call invoiced dollar amount, so measured spend is (successful images x published per-image rate). A blocked/safety-filtered image is not charged, per the provider's own error message on that response, and is excluded from total_cost_usd.
backfill_note: This file was reconstructed once by hand after generate-plates.mjs's first version overwrote its own receipt on a second, narrower run (a real bug hit while proving this script; fixed in generate-plates.mjs to merge by id going forward, see its header comment). Every value below is either copied verbatim from the live terminal output of the two actual generation runs on 2026-09-04/05, or independently re-verified afterward against the saved image files with `shasum -a 256` and `file` (see README.md 'Verification'). Nothing here is estimated. usage_metadata (exact provider token counts) was only preserved for the p-hero-blog retry, whose JSON survived; the other six successful calls' usage_metadata objects were not preserved because the original combined receipt was overwritten before being read back — their bytes/duration/cost/sha256/dimensions are still exact, measured values.
